profile.headline: Senior Data Engineer | Senior Data Analyst | AWS | SQL | Python | Tableau | Alteryx | ETL/ELT | Data Analytics & Automation
profile.summary:
With over 8 years of experience, I specialize in delivering enterprise-grade data engineering, cloud analytics, automation, and business intelligence solutions. At Charter Communications, I serve as a Software Engineer IV, leveraging AWS, SQL, and Python to build robust ETL/ELT pipelines, automate data workflows, and support analytics initiatives. My focus is on designing scalable data systems using tools such as AWS S3, Athena, Glue, and Lambda, while employing advanced SQL for integration, validation, and operational analytics.  

My expertise extends to developing and managing enterprise Tableau solutions, including dashboard creation, Tableau Server governance, extract scheduling, and data visualization. I am driven to empower organizations with data-driven insights, ensuring operational efficiency and informed decision-making. My work emphasizes collaboration and innovation, contributing to impactful data solutions that align with business objectives.

positions.title: Software Engineer IV
positions.description:
Promoted through Software Engineer II, Software Engineer III, and Software Engineer IV roles while delivering enterprise data engineering, cloud analytics, automation, and business intelligence solutions.
• Engineer production ETL/ELT pipelines using AWS S3, Athena, Glue, Lambda, EventBridge, and SNS for ingestion, transformation, validation, monitoring, and analytics.
• Develop advanced SQL across Presto/Trino, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server for data integration, reconciliation, transformation, root-cause analysis, and large-scale operational analytics.
• Build Python automation using pandas, boto3, Microsoft Graph API, SharePoint, and REST APIs to automate data processing, AWS loading, reporting, and operational workflows.
• Design data quality and monitoring frameworks with validation gates, anomaly detection, historical comparisons, and automated alerting.
• Develop and administer enterprise Tableau solutions, including Tableau Server governance, security, published data sources, extract scheduling, REST API automation, metadata analysis, and platform optimization.
• Built Tableau platform governance and utilization analytics used by leadership to identify stale content, improve platform governance, monitor adoption, and support storage optimization.
• Developed software asset analytics and classification workflows supporting license optimization and improved vendor negotiation decisions.
• Deliver operational KPI monitoring, network outage analytics, merger/integration reporting, and executive dashboards used by Directors, VPs, and senior leadership.
• Own production support, root-cause analysis, deployment validation, troubleshooting, documentation, and cross-team escalation for critical data and analytics solutions.
Technologies: AWS | SQL | Python | Tableau | Tableau Server | Alteryx | ETL/ELT | Athena | S3 | Glue | Lambda | PostgreSQL | REST APIs | GitLab
positions.insights: Skills: Teradata · Report Development · Oracle Database · Forecasting · Tableau · Python (Programming Language) · Alteryx · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · AWS Lambda · SQL · Microsoft Excel · Data Science · Amazon EC2 · Data Visualization · Data Modeling · Data Analytics · REST APIs · Gitlab · Athena · Data Engineering · AWS Glue

positions.title: Data Modelling Lead Analyst
positions.description:
Delivered business intelligence, data modeling, and reporting solutions using Tableau, SQL Server, SSRS, and Microsoft Visual Studio.
• Developed Tableau dashboards and enterprise reporting solutions by translating business requirements into reusable datasets, KPIs, and interactive visualizations.
• Designed advanced Tableau visualizations using calculated fields, parameters, filters, hierarchies, sets, groups, geographic maps, heat maps, scatter plots, and other analytical views.
• Developed and optimized SQL queries supporting reporting, data analysis, and dashboard development.
• Built and maintained SSRS reports with parameters, security controls, scheduling, automated delivery, and performance optimization.
• Partnered with business stakeholders to gather requirements, validate reporting logic, troubleshoot issues, and deliver production-ready analytics solutions.
Technologies: Tableau | SQL | SQL Server | SSRS | Business Intelligence | Data Modeling | Data Analytics | Data Visualization | Microsoft Visual Studio
positions.insights: Skills: Report Development · Forecasting · Tableau · SQL · Microsoft Excel · Data Science · Amazon EC2 · Data Visualization · Data Modeling · Data Analytics · Data Engineering

• Built sales, forecasting, and operational dashboards using calculated fields, parameters, filters, dashboard actions, reference lines, geographic analysis, and advanced visualizations.
• Optimized dashboards and data interactions for large datasets while translating reporting requirements into clear, business-facing analytics.
Technologies: Tableau | Data Analytics | Data Visualization | Business Intelligence | Excel

positions.title: Tableau developer (Freelance)
positions.description:
Developed Tableau analytics and reporting solutions supporting customer segmentation, regional sales, profitability, and operational reporting.
• Built custom SQL queries to integrate cross-database data sources and resolve differences in source structures and data types.
• Developed interactive Tableau dashboards using parameters, calculations, filters, drill-down/drill-through functionality, dashboard actions, and user-focused reporting.
• Created metrics and visualizations to analyze sales and profitability across U.S. regions and support business decision-making.
Technologies: Tableau | SQL | Data Analytics | Data Visualization | Business Intelligence
